findings.result: Every step waits VMEM/LDS and publishes producers, reads current A/scales, then waits lgkmcnt0 and block barrier before prefetch_a refills the same A stage. Current A/scales are local values before the ring storage is reused.
qb[bstage] is copied into local b before prefetch_b reuses that slot. The next step vmcnt0 completes newly issued global B loads before qb is copied. SSA value semantics preserve b while qb changes.
RING_PERIOD is LCM(NUM_STAGES,B_SLOTS), so static slot indices agree with kt modulo each queue. If loops<NUM_STAGES, only indices below loops execute, matching active_stages and matrix_bytes.

No future A/B prefetch is issued on the final K step; its entry vmcnt0 completed prior A producers and its reader retirement barrier completed LDS reads. Output1 adds a final lgkmcnt0/barrier before C alias, then a publish barrier. lds_bytes(k)=max(matrix+scale,C_BYTES) includes the complete padded C arena at short K.

findings.topic: M tails and raw resource guards
findings.result: All eight private launch traits have SplitK1/runtime K. Arbitrary M tails are bounded by global resources and the frozen scale/output helper contracts. The output/reducer body matches the frozen implementation, including output1 paths.

limits: Source review establishes schedule/mapping consistency for the eight instantiated traits. It does not validate GPU execution, numerical values, occupancy or performance.
Generic unused SplitK branches were read but are not launched by the private ABI; no new coverage claim is made for them.
